pr.title: Invoicing: add invoice export + dunning queue
pr.description_summary: Adds an invoice CSV export form, a new field on the invoices table, and introduces a background 'dunning' queue that retries failed payment reminders.

groups.title: Introduce dunning retry queue
groups.summary: New SQS-backed background queue that retries failed payment-reminder emails, with a worker and enqueue calls from the payments service.

novelty.rationale: First message queue in the codebase — new infra pattern, no prior art to follow

blast.rationale: New network boundary + touches the payments/billing path

review_focus: Is there a dead-letter queue and a bounded retry policy?
What happens on poison messages / duplicate reminders to a customer?
Is there alerting on queue depth and worker failure?

groups.title: Add invoice CSV export form
groups.summary: New export form on the invoices page that posts to a new endpoint, following the existing form + resolver pattern.

novelty.rationale: New form/endpoint but built exactly like existing ones per apps/api/AGENTS.md — check pattern fit

blast.rationale: Adds a public endpoint that reads invoice rows

review_focus: Does the resolver enforce the same auth/tenant scoping as sibling resolvers?
Is the export paginated/streamed, or could a large tenant OOM it?

groups.title: Add 'exported_at' field to invoices
groups.summary: Nullable timestamp column + DTO field, set when an invoice is exported.

novelty.rationale: Standard additive field following the existing migration pattern

review_focus: Confirm the column is nullable / has a safe default (no table rewrite lock on a hot billing table)

groups.title: Tests, fixtures, and seed data
groups.summary: Unit + integration tests for the export form and queue, plus seed invoices.

novelty.rationale: Test/seed additions following existing test conventions

review_focus: Skim: do the queue tests cover the retry/DLQ path?
